caption: The drawing depicts a single wingback armchair prominently centered on a blank, neutral background. The chair’s upholstery is rendered in a light turquoise blue color, with subtle shading to indicate curves and depth. The chair features high, rounded wings on either side of the tall backrest, which flows smoothly into curved armrests. There are two seat cushions, each illustrated with fine contour lines. The four visible chair legs are slender, straight, and depicted in a light reddish-brown tone, contrasting with the blue upholstery. The front two legs are turned and detailed, while the rear legs are more simply rendered. The artist’s signature, “W.W. Jennings,” appears near the lower right corner of the chair, close to one of the front legs. The background is plain and unshaded, emphasizing the chair as the central object in the composition.
title: Duncan Phyfe Chair
